PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Builds Python tools to process test-rig data, check results against specifications, and generate reports. Developed an internal processing tool used by four test engineers and a Power BI dashboard used by around 15 colleagues. Experienced with Python, SQL Server, MATLAB/Simulink and test data; currently completing an online data engineering course.

EXPERIENCE

Test & Validation Engineer | Corvane Automotive Components | Setúbal
Mar 2019–Present
- Plan and run durability, vibration and climatic tests on seat-adjuster mechanisms across six servo-hydraulic and electric test rigs; prepare reports for OEM customers.
- Develop Python scripts to parse TDMS and CSV rig outputs (around 2 GB per week), check channels against test specifications, and generate standard report figures. Reduced report preparation from about three days to half a day per test.
- Maintain an internal data-processing tool scheduled nightly on a laboratory PC. It writes summary results to a staging table in the plant’s SQL Server database and is used by four other test engineers.
- Query the plant’s test-results database for trend analysis across three product generations.
- Built a Power BI dashboard using the staging table to show pass/fail trends and cycles to failure by product generation; used by around 15 validation and design engineers.
- Correlate rig results with FEA in ANSYS Mechanical and lead 8D root-cause analysis on field failures. Proposed a redesigned adjuster rail bracket that cut warranty returns for the part by 40%.
- Maintain MATLAB/Simulink models of the adjuster drive, used to select rig load profiles that match customer duty cycles.
- Trained three apprentices in rig safety and test setup (2022–2024).

Mechanical Design Engineer | Halvik Pumps | Porto
Sep 2014–Feb 2019
- Designed centrifugal pump casings and impellers in SolidWorks and produced manufacturing drawings with GD&T; owned DFMEA for two product lines.
- Performed structural FEA of casings in ANSYS. Supported a move from grey cast iron to ductile iron for one casing family, saving 12% in material cost.
- Wrote a LabVIEW data-acquisition program for the pump performance test bench, reducing test setup time from about two hours to 30 minutes.
- Supported conversion of the performance test bench to a Siemens S7 PLC-controlled setup, changing setpoints and timers in TIA Portal under the automation engineer’s supervision.
